request.style: English, warm male baritone solo, soft acoustic guitar, gentle piano, light strings, hopeful and reverent mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They faithfully brought in the contributions
The tithes and the dedicated gifts
Conaniah the Levite was in charge
Managing every holy thing
His brother Shimei was second in command
Serving under the King

[Verse]
Jehiel and Azaziah served as supervisors
Nahath and Asahel too
By appointment of King Hezekiah
And Azariah the official
They distributed the gifts fairly
To the priests and Levites

[Verse]
Kore son of Imnah was the gatekeeper
At the East Gate he stood
In charge of freewill offerings
For God and for the LORD
He distributed the consecrated gifts
With a faithful heart

[Verse]
Eden and Miniamin helped him out
Jeshua and Shemaiah
In the towns of the priests they worked
Dividing by their turns
To old and young alike they gave
With steady hands

[Outro]
He sought his God and worked wholeheartedly
